Translation: Left-click a building in the map view, then click the door handle {doorhandleicon} to step inside.
Some buildings have opening hours or are not accessible to everyone. In those cases, the door handle will not be available.
At your business, left-click a worker portrait. Once attached to the cursor, left-click the activity you want to assign them to.
Make sure you have the materials they need in the storeroom.

Visit the Marketplace, you can do so by using the red buttons {marketplaceicon} on the left. To buy an item for personal use, left-click it, then left-click an empty slot in your {inventoryicon} personal inventory.
To buy crafting materials for your business, send your cart to the Marketplace and place the purchased materials in one of the cart's slots instead.
You can also visit other workshops. Any items they have for sale in their storefront can be loaded directly into your cart.

At your business, load the cart by left-clicking an item, then left-clicking a cart slot. You can then send the cart to the {marketplaceicon} Marketplace. Once it arrives, left-click an item in the cart, then left-click the highlighted area to immediatly sell it.
You can also sell items directly from your business by moving them from the storeroom to the storefront and waiting for a customer to purchase them.
To use an item, it must be in your {inventoryicon}personal inventory. Right-click the item to open its context menu, then select Use. Finally, confirm who or what you want to use the item on.
You can load {I_TYP_INVITE_C}inventory items{##} into your personal inventory, either from the Marketplace or from your own business.
Your personal inventory is the coin purse {inventoryicon} beside your character portrait in the bottom-left corner.
Sell {value} worth of items at the marketplace
Sell {value} worth of items from the storefront
Open your business and select the Business tab. Use the {WOR_SAL_C}Salary{##} and {WOR_TRE_C}Treatment{##} sliders to decide how much your workers earn and how well they are treated.
Define the treatment you want to give your workers
Open your business and select the Business tab. Use the {WOR_SAL_C}Salary{##} and {WOR_TRE_C}Treatment{##} sliders to decide how much your workers earn and how well they are treated.

Prove yourself worthy of being heard and start climbing the political ladder.\n\nIn the left sidebar, click {HB_POL} Politics to view the {O_TYP_CIVOFF_C}office{##} hierarchy. Choose a position for which you meet the requirements, then {O_ELE_C}apply for office{##}.
Assign a worker to a task

You use your workers to provide services and craft goods in exchange for a salary at the end of each turn. Keep them busy — idle workers still expect to be paid.

At your business, {CC_LMB} left-click a worker portrait. Once attached to the cursor, {CC_LMB} left-click the {A_ACT_C}task{##} you want to assign them to.

Workers perform assigned tasks during their {WORHOU_C}working hours{##}, but you can assign a task before they arrive so they begin as soon as their shift starts.
Get a purse of persuasion in your house
Inside your house, find the {B_IMP_icon} {B_IMP_BRI_C}Purse of Persuasion{##} improvement and build it.

On the left, open {HB_ALLCHA} Townsfolk and locate your target. {CC_RMB} Right-click their portrait and select {A_BRI_C}Bribe{##}. You can also access their portrait through their character details and, in some cases, from other places such as Politics.
Get a queen bee in the timberlands

On the map, find the {B_EXTFAC_WOOARE_C}Timberlands{##}. Use {HB_FIL} Filters to highlight {B_TYP_EXTFAC_C}Resource Sites{##}, then select the Timberlands and choose {A_CATBEE_C}Hunt for Queen Bee{##}.

With the {I_BEEQUE_C}Queen Bee{##} in your {HB_INV} {CHAR_PERINV_C}Personal Inventory{##}, open {HB_CONMEN} Construction Menu  on the left. In the Personal tab, choose the {B_PER_BEEHIV_C}Beehive{##} you want to build and select where to place it. The Queen Bee will be used automatically when construction begins.
Build an improvement in your smithy

When you build improvements, you pay a small upfront cost in exchange for benefits over time. Sometimes, you will have to choose between two or more types of improvement.\n\nInside your smithy, select an {B_IMP_icon} Improvement of your choice and build it.

When you build improvements, you pay a small upfront cost in exchange for benefits over time. Sometimes, you will have to choose between two or more types of improvement.\n\nEnter either your house or your business and choose an {B_IMP_icon} improvement to build.

On the left, click {HB_MKT} Marketplace to open the market. To buy an item for yourself, {CC_LMB} left-click it, then {CC_LMB} left-click an empty slot in your {HB_INV} {CHAR_PERINV_C}Personal Inventory{##}.

Nothing comes from nothing, so make sure your workers have what they need.

Prices rise and fall with supply and demand, so keep an eye on the marketplace and have a cart ready whenever a good deal appears.

To buy {I_TYP_RAWMAT_C}crafting materials{##}, send your {CAR_C}cart{##} to the {B_PUB_MKT_C}Marketplace{##}, place the purchased items in its slots, then send the cart back to your smithy. Make sure to keep your carts in good {B_HP_C}repair{##} so they don't break down.

Humans have invented many ways to order society and rank one another's worth. In this society, {T_C}titles{##} come before names and define your rights.

As soon as you have acquired enough {CHAR_WEA_C}wealth{##} to be considered a {T_FULCIT_C}burgher{##}, make it official by claiming the title at the town hall.

In the left sidebar, click {HB_TOWHAL} {B_PUB_TOWHAL_C}Town Hall{##}, or open {HB_PERACT} Personal Actions, and select {T_C}Claim Next Title{##}.

No one lives forever, and more important than being remembered well is ensuring that your legacy endures for generations. To have legitimate children who will carry on your name, you must marry — and before you can marry, you must court.\n\nNext to your portrait in the bottom-left corner, click your dynasty banner to open your family tree. From there, click {A_COU_C}Begin Courtship{##}, choose someone to court, and begin the path toward marriage.
Sweet-talk the person you are courting
After choosing someone to {A_COU_C}court{##}, {CC_RMB} right-click their portrait and select {A_SWETAL_C}Sweet-talk Love Interest{##}. This may impress them and help you win their hand sooner.

Once you have assigned a worker to a crafting task, make sure you have the materials they need in the {B_STOROO_C}storeroom{##}.\n\nWorkers only perform assigned tasks during their {WORHOU_C}working hours{##}, so don't expect anything to be produced before their shift starts.

In the left sidebar, click {HB_MYBUS} My Business to center the camera on your {B_OCC_SMI_C}smithy{##}. Then click the door handle to step inside, or zoom in for a better look and double-click the building to enter.

From learning new skills, to interacting with your family, to plotting and scheming, there's no place better for it than the intimacy of your home.\n\nIn the left sidebar, click {HB_MYHOU} My Property to center camera on your house. Then click the door handle or double-click on the house to step inside.

Competence comes with a certificate, or so they say. If you want to advance as a {P_C}smith{##}, you must earn a {A_MASGRA_C}Mastery Grade{##}. It will increase your {CHAR_REN_C}renown{##} and allow you to upgrade to a larger smithy, where you can craft more goods and provide more services.\n\nIn the left sidebar, open {HB_PERACT} Personal Actions and select {A_MASGRA_C}Gain Mastery Grade{##}.
Visit the Prison and serve as a guard

You have done your part: paid your taxes and followed the rules. Sadly, criminals rarely do the same. If you want safer streets, volunteer as a guard for a short time. You'll earn some money while reminding wrongdoers that someone is watching.\n\nOn the map, find a {B_PUB_PRI_C}Prison{##}. Use {HB_FIL} Filters to highlight {B_TYP_PUBBUI_C}City Infrastructure{##}, then select a Prison and choose {A_GUASER_C}Sign Up for Guard Service{##}.

Once you are married, you may have a {CHAR_HEI_C}child{##}. The {CHAR_CHABABY_C}chance{##} depends on both spouses' {CHAR_HP_C}health{##}, age, and {CHAR_STA_C}opinion{##} of each other. Using {A_PRITIM_C}Spend Private Time{##} can improve the chances, but it is neither required nor a guarantee.
Hire escorts to protect your cart on the road

The road may be long and full of perils. Your cart may be attacked, so if you are transporting valuable goods best to hire an escort.\n\nClick your cart and select {A_HIRESC_C}Hire Escort{##}. Then choose the level of protection and how many {C_TRN_C}turns{##} you want the escort to remain hired.

More hands get more done.\n\nAt your business, open the Activities tab. Under Workers, click the + icon in an available slot to hire an additional worker. You can also build the Workforce improvement to unlock one more worker slot.
At your house, after acquiring the necessary improvements, select {A_IMPSKI_C}Improve Skills{##}, then choose a skill to improve.
Get an Artisan's Toolbox for your house
Inside your house, build the {B_IMP_icon} {B_IMP_IMPHAN_C}Artisan's Toolbox{##} improvement.
Go to your house and improve handicraft

Different skills for different jobs. As a smith, handicraft affects {CHAR_PRO_C}productivity{##} at your smithy, so best to improve it.\n\nAt your house, after acquiring the {B_IMP_IMPHAN_C}Artisan's Toolbox{##}, select the action {A_IMPSKI_C}Improve Skills{##}, then choose {S_HAN_C}Handicraft{##}.

Apprentices gain {CHAR_XP_C}experience{##} over time. Once they have gained enough, you can {A_PROWOR_C}promote{##} them to journeymen, making them more {CHAR_PRO_C}productive{##} and less prone to accidents. This takes time, but you can hasten their progress by mentoring them yourself.\n\nAt your business, {CC_RMB} right-click a worker's portrait and select {A_TRAWOREXP_C}Mentor{##}.

At your business, {CC_RMB} right-click a worker's portrait and select {A_TRAWORSKI_C}Train Skill{##}. Smithy workers with greater {S_HAN_C}Handicraft{##} skill will be more {CHAR_PRO_C}productive{##}.

After choosing someone to {A_COU_C}court{##}, your relationship will naturally grow over the years until you marry. You can speed things up by {A_SWETAL_C}sweet-talking{##} them and {A_SENGIF_C}sending gifts{##}. And if they have other suitors, consider {A_SMEREP_C}sabotaging the competition{##}.
Go to your smithy and oversee work
At your smithy, open the Actions tab and select {A_OVEPRO_C}Oversee Work{##}.

You can obtain {CR_EVI_C}evidence{##} by {A_SPY_C}spying{##} on others, though you will need a {B_IMP_SPY_C}spyglass{##} to do so. Alternatively, you can {A_SNI_C}report rumors{##} to {O_CHA_INF_C}informants{##}. While closely observing the people around you and earning some money in the process, you may uncover evidence of crimes!\n\nOnce you have obtained evidence, open {HB_CRIEVI} Crime and Evidence on the left and select {A_PRECHA_C}Press Charges{##}.

Once you have obtained {CR_EVI_C}evidence{##}, use it to gain advantage over your opponents. Open {HB_CRIEVI} Crime and Evidence in the left sidebar, select {A_PRECHA_C}Press Charges{##}, and wait for the accused to go to trial.
Spend private time with your spouse
After getting married, {CC_RMB} right-click your spouse's portrait and select {A_PRITIM_C}Spend Private Time{##}. You can also find this action under {HB_PERACT} Personal Actions.
After a worker has gained enough {CHAR_XP_C}experience{##}, {CC_RMB} right-click their portrait at your business and select {A_PROWOR_C}Promote Worker{##}.

Your building's {B_HP_C}integrity{##} affects its value, and if {ST_STR_BADMAI_C}neglected{##}, the damage will affect almost every aspect of it. Your workers will become less {CHAR_PRO_C}productive{##} and more prone to accidents, so don't let your building fall into disrepair.\n\nAt one of your buildings, click {IC_REP} Repair near the integrity bar.
Place item in storefront and wait for purchase

At your business, {CC_LMB} left-click an item in the {B_STOROO_C}storeroom{##}, then {CC_LMB} left-click an empty {B_STOFRO_C}storefront{##} slot to place it there. \n\nYour smithy's {B_PARAM_ATT_C}appeal{##} periodically draws in customers to buy items from your storefront, so just make sure they have something to buy.
Once the loaded {CAR_C}cart{##} arrives at the {B_PUB_MKT_C}marketplace{##}, {CC_LMB} left-click an item in the cart, then {CC_LMB} left-click the highlighted area to sell it immediately.
Send your cart to the marketplace

Use {CAR_C}carts{##} to purchase materials and deliver finished products to various locations. 

If you are ready to sell your crafted goods, load the cart at your business by {CC_LMB} left-clicking an item, then {CC_LMB} left-clicking a cart slot; select the {B_PUB_MKT_C}marketplace{##} from the map or from the list of buildings, and send the cart off.

If you prefer to craft and stock your goods while waiting to make a good deal from market fluctuations, you can send an empty cart to the marketplace to buy materials so your workers can keep crafting.

In the speed controls at the top of the screen, use a button or a key such as Space bar to resume the game at a speed that feels comfortable for you.\n\nAlways keep an eye on the timeline and {HB_UPCOMEVE}Upcoming Events to stay informed about your workers' {WORHOU_C}working hours{##} and never miss an election.

Once you have reached the required {A_MASGRA_C}Mastery Grade{##} and saved enough money, you can upgrade your business. This unlocks more {A_ACT_C}tasks{##} for your workers and may also grant you new {A_C}actions{##}.

To use an item, it must be in your {HB_INV} {CHAR_PERINV_C}Personal Inventory{##}. {CC_RMB} Right-click the item to open its context menu, then select Use. Finally, confirm who or what you want to use the item on.
On the map, find a {B_OCC_PRE_C}Church{##}. Use {HB_FIL} Filters to highlight {B_TYP_OCCBUI_C}Profession Buildings{##}, then select a Church and choose {A_PRA_C}Pray{##}.
Visit a guild house and train your profession

On the map, find the {B_GUILD_C}guild house{##} for your {P_C}profession{##}. Use {HB_FIL} Filters to highlight {B_TYP_PUBBUI_C}City Infrastructure{##}, then select your guild house and choose {A_TRAPRO_C}Train in Profession{##}.
On the map, find an {B_OCC_INN_C}Inn{##}. Use {HB_FIL} Filters to highlight {B_TYP_OCCBUI_C}Profession Buildings{##}, then select an Inn and choose {A_SOCATINN_C}Socialize{##}.
Visit the Town Hall and report rumors

You can obtain {CR_EVI_C}evidence{##} by {A_SPY_C}spying{##} on others, though you will need to get a {B_IMP_SPY_C}spyglass{##} at your house to do so. Alternatively, you can {A_SNI_C}report rumors{##} to {O_CHA_INF_C}informants{##}, from whom you can earn some money while also having the chance to uncover evidence of crimes!\n\nIn the left sidebar, click {HB_TOWHAL} {B_PUB_TOWHAL_C}Town Hall{##} and select {A_SNI_C}Report Rumors{##}.

After applying for {O_TYP_CIVOFF_C}office{##}, check {HB_UPCOMEVE} Upcoming Events to see when the {O_ELE_C}election{##} will take place. Improve your {S_RHE_C}Rhetoric{##} or raise the appointers' {CHAR_STA_C}opinion{##} of you to increase your chances against the other candidates.
Well done! You've achieved a goal:\n • {description}
